title: AK_QMUL at ArGuard Shared Tasks: A Single Fine-Tuned JAIS for Arabic Harmful-Prompt Detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.36360v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present AK_QMUL's submissions to the ArGuard-2026 shared tasks on Arabic harmful-prompt detection: a binary safe/unsafe task (B1) and a seven-way harm-domain task (B2). Both submissions use one backbone -- JAIS-6.7B fine-tuned with 4-bit QLoRA and a linear classification head over its last-token representation. For B1 we train a four-way head that factors the label by dialect register {safe, unsafe} x {MSA, other}, we augment the training fold with MSA prompts from AraSafe, and decode with a plain argmax to score safe/unsafe. For B2 we fine-tune the same backbone as a seven-way classifier and average the softmax outputs of five random seeds. Both submissions ranked first on their track, with macro-F1 0.984 on B1 and 0.790 on B2. We report results by dialect and by class: on B1 the model is accurate across all six dialects (93.6--99.8%) and its predicted unsafe rate tracks the true rate closely; on B2 six of the seven classes reach F1

translated_title: AK_QMUL参加ArGuard共享任务：使用单一微调JAIS模型进行阿拉伯语有害提示检测
translated_abstract: 我们展示了AK_QMUL团队提交给ArGuard-2026阿拉伯语有害提示检测共享任务的成果，包含二分类安全/不安全任务（B1）和七分类危害领域任务（B2）。两个提交均使用同一骨干网络——采用4位QLoRA微调的JAIS-6.7B，并在其最后一个token的表示上添加线性分类头。对于B1任务，我们训练了一个四分类头，将标签按语域和方言分解为{安全， 不安全} x {现代标准阿拉伯语(MSA), 其他}，并利用来自AraSafe的MSA提示对训练集进行数据增强，最后使用简单的argmax解码来判定安全/不安全。对于B2任务，我们将相同的骨干网络微调为七分类器，并对五个随机种子的softmax输出取平均值。两个提交均在各自赛道排名第一，B1的宏平均F1达到0.984，B2的宏平均F1达到0.790。我们按方言和类别报告结果：在B1上，模型在全部六种方言中均表现准确（93.6%–99.8%），且其预测的不安全比例与真实比例高度吻合；在B2上，七个类别中有六个达到了F1
tldr: AK_QMUL团队仅用一个经4位QLoRA微调的JAIS-6.7B模型，在ArGuard-2026阿拉伯语有害提示检测共享任务的两个赛道（二分类和七分类）上均获得第一名，宏F1分别达到0.984和0.790。
en_tdlr: AK_QMUL achieved first place in both tracks of the ArGuard-2026 Arabic harmful-prompt detection shared tasks using a single JAIS-6.7B model fine-tuned with 4-bit QLoRA, with macro-F1 scores of 0.984 and 0.790.
